Subject: Velocity gate: weekly submission & precall checklist

Team — quick weekly nudge into Monday rhythm for the Velocity Gate and our precall prep next Tuesday. Please treat this as the final window to get stages accurate and submit your numbers into HubSpot before the review call. Key asks: 

1) Update stages and close probabilities on all deals in your lane by EOD Friday (2026-11-06). Focus on any Opportunity -> Commit moves; if you move a deal to Commit, add a one-line rationale in the "Commit reason" field.

2) Attach the latest pipeline snapshot to HubSpot (I attached a CSV stub) and flag any deals with open procurement/security blockers.

3) Join the precall Tuesday 11/10 10:30–11:00 PT — quick run of risky deals, canaries, and last-mile actions. Meeting invite will come from Marissa.

Precall agenda (short):
- 10:30 — Quick numbers check (who shifted lanes)
- 10:38 — Top 5 at-risk deals — owner updates (30s each)
- 10:50 — Escalations & ask for leadership credits/discounts
- 10:56 — Confirm final submission window and owner signoffs

Attachments: pipeline_snapshot_20261109.csv (snapshot), precall_agenda_20261110.pdf (agenda + slots)

Why this matters: finance closes the submission on Wednesday morning and any late stage flips after the window create downstream reconciliation. If you have a blocker with legal/procurement for a Commit move, mark it in HubSpot and ping the revenue-ops thread immediately.

Thanks — Priya
